proof_scope: In progress. R1764 proves jointly feasible parameters and the conditional continuous-expansion theorem. ExpansionParameters chooses m=ceil(8*eta*K), sigma=1/(100*K^2), delta=K*(K-1)*sigma, and proves every numeric hypothesis for eta<=1/1000000 and K>=10000. Uniformity follows from actual small augmented expansion. NormalizedCellCorrelation supplies a measurable representative of the existing normalized L2 class, exact unit squared integral, unit support, zero integrals on both open and closed cells, and correlation at least 3/4. ConditionalSpectralExpansion proves integrability of weighted products, equality of the symmetric correlation average with the integral of the averaged weighted action, and the continuous expansion bound with margin sigma from the explicit RestrictedCorrelationGap premise. It handles null sets separately and derives positive variance for positive-measure sets. The bound transfers to the existing open-domain interface; an eventual-gap premise yields a fixed nonempty rational expanding family. Existence of RestrictedCorrelationGap is not asserted.
